EN:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Rainy days make me even sleepier
than usual,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Good thing you came to visit, 'cause
your face is like a big ol' alarm
clock!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} I feel more awake already!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Los días lluviosos me dan aún más
sueño de lo normal,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Qué bien que has venido de visita,
¡porque tu cara es como un gran
despertador!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} ¡Ya estoy despierto!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Les jours pluvieux je m'endors
encore plus facilement que les
autres jours,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Au moins, quand tu es là, je ne
m'endors pas !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Tu as le don de me
filer la patate, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Le giornate di pioggia
mi fanno venire sonno
più del solito,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Meno male che sei venut{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} tu!
Sei la mia sveglia parlante!
{{TAG:0002:0000:}}Dopo, però, torno a letto!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Der Regen macht mich noch
müder als sonst,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Zum Glück bist du vorbeigekommen,
{{TAG:0005:0000:}}, sonst hätte ich noch
den ganzen Tag verschlafen.

TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Bütün sabah keyfim tavan.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Bu yağmur gerçekten en güzeli,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
Hiya, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}. I'm so glad you
came to visit even though it's
raining,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
Hola, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}. Me alegro de que
hayas venido de visita incluso con
esta lluvia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
Salut, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}. Content de voir
que la pluie ne te décourage pas de
venir nous voir,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
Ehilà, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}. Mi fa piacere che
tu sia venut{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} a trovarci nonostante
la pioggia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
Hallo, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Zum Glück hat
dich der Regen nicht von einem
Besuch abgehalten,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
Selam, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}. Yağmur yağmasına
rağmen ziyarete gelmene
çok sevindim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}You're not bummed that it's raining
during your visit, are you?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Don't worry. There's plenty of fun
stuff to do in {{TAG:0005:0005:}} on rainy
days,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}No te molestará mucho que llueva
cuando vienes de visita, ¿no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}No te preocupes, hay mucho que
hacer en {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} para divertirse
cuando hay lluvia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ça ne te dérange pas trop qu'il
pleuve comme ça le jour où tu viens
nous rendre une petite visite ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Ne t'inquiète pas, on ne s'ennuie
jamais à {{TAG:0005:0005:}}. Même pas les
jours de pluie,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Non ti scoccia che si sia messo
a piovere durante la tua visita?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Non ti preoccupare, {{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0005:0005:}},
quando piove, ci si diverte lo stesso
da matti,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Hättest du dir schöneres Wetter
für deinen Besuch gewünscht,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Keine Sorge, in {{TAG:0005:0005:}} kann
man auch an verregneten Tagen
jede Menge Spaß haben.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ziyaretin sırasında yağmur yağıyor diye
moralin bozulmadı, değil mi?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}
Merak etme. {{TAG:0005:0005:}}'da yağmurlu
günlerde de yapılacak bir sürü eğlenceli
şey var,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0000:}} est dans la place
aujourd'hui !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Génial ! Ça rend ce jour de pluie
doublement agréable,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}The rain gives {{TAG:0005:0005:}} kind of a
mysterious feel, doesn't it?{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}It's like
we're in a movie,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}La lluvia le da a {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} un aire
misterioso, ¿a que sí?{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}¡Es como si
fuera una película,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}C'est bizarre... {{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}}Quand il pleut sur
{{TAG:0005:0005:}} la nuit, ça fait comme
une drôle de sensation...
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Un peu comme si on était dans un
film noir,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} tu trouves pas,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}La pioggia avvolge {{TAG:0005:0005:}} in
un'aura di mistero, vero?{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}Mi sembra
di essere in un film,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you're not into the whole rain
thing, you should take cover in
someone's house, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Don't worry about weirding anyone
out.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Everyone in {{TAG:0005:0005:}} likes
visitors,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si a ti no te va eso de la lluvia,
deberías protegerte de ella
en casa de alguien, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}No te preocupes, que nadie se va
a molestar.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡En {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} a todos
nos gustan las visitas,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si tu n'aimes pas la pluie tu peux
toujours t'abriter chez quelqu'un,
{{TAG:0005:0000:}}. Ne te gêne surtout pas.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ici à {{TAG:0005:0005:}}, tout le monde aime
recevoir de la visite,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se non ti piace stare sotto la
pioggia, puoi sempre cercare riparo
a casa di qualcuno, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Non ti preoccupare: nessuno si
sorprenderà.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Noi di {{TAG:0005:0005:}}
siamo ospitali,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn Regen nichts für dich ist,
könntest du dich irgendwo
unterstellen, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Es macht bestimmt niemandem
was aus, wenn du plötzlich ins Haus
gestolpert kommst,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yağmur olayını sevmiyorsan birinin evine
sığın, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Kimseyi tuhaf hissettiririm diye düşünme.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0005:}}'da herkes misafir sever,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Rainy nights are the best times to
take a walk,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aaah... Décidément, les promenades
nocturnes sous la pluie sont bien
celles que je préfère,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le serate di pioggia sono
il momento migliore per fare
una passeggiata, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yağmurlu geceler yürüyüş yapmak
için en güzel zamanlar,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}AAAH!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ma, insomma, dico...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ti sembra il caso di aggirarsi così
di soppiatto in una notte buia e
tempestosa come questa?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Mi è preso un coccolone,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0000:}}, il est tard et il pleut.
Il est plus que temps d'aller se
mettre au lit.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sérieux, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0019:}}Es ist schon spät und es gießt wie
aus Eimern, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wir sollten
schlafen gehen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

FR:
Alors tu es comme moi pour ça,
{{TAG:0005:0000:}} ? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tu aimes sortir la nuit
par temps de pluie,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
Ehi, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}, anche a te
piacciono le giornate di pioggia,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hola, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿No te parece
que empaparte con la lluvia es lo
mejor que hay,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ciao, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}! Anche a te
piace sentire la pioggia che ti bagna
la faccia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
